caption: The drawing depicts a single, cylindrical straight-sided jar with a slightly flared rim and a pronounced shoulder near the top. The jar is colored in various shades of brown, with darker areas suggesting shadows and wear. The surface of the jar shows signs of chipping and uneven texture, and there is a large yellow marking resembling the number "21" painted on its front. The jar sits on a flat, brown, wood-textured surface. The background is a plain, light beige color, and above the jar, there is uppercase text reading "STRAIGHT SIDED JAR EARLY 19th CENTURY" printed in grey capital letters.
title: Preserve Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
